abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the imaging findings of mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation (malignant teratoma) compared with the corresponding mature cystic teratoma (benign teratoma). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study enrolled 1325 patients with 12 malignant teratomas and 1313 benign teratomas. We compared the computed tomographic (CT) findings of eight malignant teratomas and 15 benign teratomas; both groups were matched in terms of tumor size (>9.9 cm) and patient age (>45 years). The CT images were retrospectively evaluated with focus on soft tissue components; size, border (regular or irregular), the presence or absence of nodular formation, enhancement, the angle formed between the soft tissue components and the inner wall of the cyst (acute or obtuse), and transmural growth as well as metastasis including lymphadenopathy and disseminated disease. Using the Fischer's Exact test, each evaluating parameter was compared between the two groups. RESULTS: Soft tissue components were observed in 75% (six of eight) of malignant teratomas and in 33% (five of fifteen) of benign teratomas; 100% (six of six) of soft component in malignant teratomas had a nodular formation and none of soft component in benign teratomas showed nodular formation; 83% (five of six) of soft component in malignant teratomas had enhancement as well as an obtuse angle between the soft tissue components and the inner wall of the cyst. None of soft component in benign teratomas showed enhancement and 20% (one of five) of soft component in benign teratomas had an obtuse angle; 33% (two of six) of soft component in malignant teratomas showed transmural growth, 13% (one of eight) of malignant teratoma showed lymphadenopathy, and 38% (three of eight) showed disseminated disease. None of benign teratomas showed transmural growth, lymphadenopathy, or disseminated disease. A statistically significant difference between patients with and without malignant transformation was seen in terms of nodular formation, obtuse angle, and enhancement of the soft tissue components (P<.05). CONCLUSION: Malignant teratoma is characterized by the following imaging findings: the presence of a nodular forming and enhancing soft tissue component, an obtuse angle between the soft tissue and the inner wall of the cyst, as well as extracapsular tumor growth with extension into adjacent structures or metastasis. Therefore, we can differentiate malignant teratoma from benign teratoma using CT findings.

目的：悪性転化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（悪性奇形腫）のCT所見を、対応する成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（良性奇形腫）と比較して評価すること。
材料と方法：本研究では1325例の患者を登録し、悪性奇形腫12例と良性奇形腫1313例が含まれた。腫瘍サイズ（9.9cm超）と患者年齢（45歳超）で適合させた悪性奇形腫8例と良性奇形腫15例のCT所見を比較した。CT画像は、軟部成分について大きさ、境界（規則的または不規則）、結節形成の有無、造影効果、軟部成分と嚢胞内壁のなす角度（鋭角または鈍角）、壁貫通性の進展、リンパ節腫大や播種性病変を含む転移の有無を中心に後方視的に評価した。各評価項目はフィッシャーの正確検定で比較した。
結果：軟部成分は悪性奇形腫の75%（8例中6例）、良性奇形腫の33%（15例中5例）に認められた。悪性奇形腫の軟部成分では100%（6例中6例）に結節形成があり、良性奇形腫では結節形成を示したものはなかった。悪性奇形腫の軟部成分の83%（6例中5例）は造影効果を示し、鈍角を示した。良性奇形腫の軟部成分では造影効果は認められず、鈍角を示したのは20%（5例中1例）であった。悪性奇形腫の軟部成分の33%（6例中2例）は壁貫通性の進展を示し、悪性奇形腫の13%（8例中1例）にリンパ節腫大、38%（8例中3例）に播種性病変が認められた。良性奇形腫では壁貫通性の進展、リンパ節腫大、播種性病変は認められなかった。悪性転化の有無により、結節形成、鈍角、造影効果の軟部成分について統計学的に有意な差がみられた（P<.05）。
結論：悪性奇形腫は、結節状で造影される軟部成分、軟部成分と嚢胞内壁の鈍角、そして隣接構造への進展や転移を伴う壁外への腫瘍増大を特徴とする。したがって、CT所見を用いて悪性奇形腫と良性奇形腫を鑑別できる。
